record.rationale: Realm-local C SAX callback ABI binding installs original error/warning/resolver signatures on actual parser contexts. Compiled C trampolines erase only unused printf/varargs arguments. Static native table entries live for the module lifetime; unique registration identities prevent an older scope from removing a replacement even with the same callback object. Native _private and XML policy are unchanged. Actual C callbacks, nested parsing and original XML fixtures pass; actual UNO graph, stream IO, typed diagnostics, live mutation lists and Unicode also pass in Chromium main realm and a module Worker without DOM globals. Full DocumentBuilder/UCB service, source bootstrap QA, physical C++ ABI and complete DOCX/XLSX/UI acceptance remain unverified.
